Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left-turn lane at an intersection in Houston, Texas, when the collision occurred. Driver 1
stated that the vehicle was turning left when it was struck by Driver 2's vehicle, which had entered the intersection
from the opposite direction. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the applicable policy. Passenger was seated in
the fornt passenger seat at the time of the impact and reported neck pain consistent with whiplash. The reported
injury appears consistent with the type and force of a broadside impact of this kind. Damage to the vehicle, including
the driver-side front quarter panel and door, matches the impact described by the parties. Photographs taken at the
scene confirm several of these details. No independent witnesses to the collision were identified. Responding officers
and the parties present confirmed that Passenger was inside the vehicle at the time. No prior damage to the vehicle
has been reported or observed. Officers have documented the scene and will forward the report for review.
